display_long_description:
ReframeXR is an immersive learning platform built for everyday classrooms.

It helps teachers design, facilitate, and observe small-group, spatial learning experiences that make complex ideas easier to understand.

Educators use ReframeXR to create immersive lessons that integrate directly into their physical classroom. Teachers place interactive learning stations in the room, guide students through hands-on exploration, and lead discussion in real time. Students collaborate through shared spatial experiences that support discourse, problem-solving, and deeper understanding across subject areas.

ReframeXR keeps teachers at the center of instruction. Lessons are teacher-led, classroom-based, and aligned to existing instructional models such as station rotation and small-group learning. The platform supports clarity and structure while giving students new ways to experience abstract concepts through spatial exploration.

Key features:
Immersive lesson creation with spatial learning activities
Teacher-led facilitation and real-time classroom control
Shared, collaborative learning experiences for small groups
Live observation of student progress and engagement
Flexible use across subjects and grade levels

Designed for:
Teachers who want immersive learning without losing instructional control
Schools looking to support collaboration, engagement, and spatial reasoning
Districts seeking classroom-ready immersive tools that scale with instruction
